name: Ghosts of Tabor: Florida Man DLC
summary:
AdvantEDGE is currently deploying pedestrian relaxation apparel to units operating in Tabor due to a shortage of standard military uniforms.

The issued clothing is classified as non-military and does not conform to approved combat specifications. However, these garments may improve field adaptability, increase wearer relaxation, and better support non-combat operational conditions.

Operators are advised that combat effectiveness remains the responsibility of the wearer.

New Character Shirt Options are:

Shaka Shirt
Vice Shirt
Gunbana Shirt
Pinegrenade Shirt
LZ Shirt

New Character Bottom Options are:

Duckops Shorts
Navy Shorts
Cargo Shorts
Chinos Pants

New Character Shoe Options are:

Blue Flip Flops
Brown Sandles

New Gun Charm:

Flamingo Gun Charm

New Universal Gun Skin:

Gator Hide Universal Gun Skin
